claims.text: Sulfasalazine CI: intestinal or urinary obstruction, porphyria, or hypersensitivity to sulfasalazine, its metabolites, sulfonamides or salicylates.
claims.quote: Patients with intestinal or urinary obstruction, Patients with porphyria as sulfonamides have been reported to precipitate an acute attack, Patients hypersensitive to sulfasalazine, its metabolites, sulfonamides, or salicylates.

claims.text: Sulfasalazine: CBC with differential and LFTs before starting, every second week for the first three months, monthly for the next three months, then every three months.
claims.quote: Complete blood counts, including differential white cell count, and liver function tests, should be performed before starting AZULFIDINE and every second week during the first three months of therapy. During the second three months, the same tests should be done once monthly and thereafter once every three months
